Chat bubbles assemble from get_messages/get_entries plus live stream; four message roles render distinctly (user/assistant/toolResult/bashExecution).

Session list is relay-built from --session-dir scanning plus entry tree metadata; fork/clone/get_tree/set_session_name support Claude-style session UX.
Approvals are extension-UI dialogs; parity evidence shows decision-ready approval cards and host permission-mode mirroring are the differentiators (Remote Control approval fatigue).
Claude UX parity model: chat-as-control-plane, streaming shells, full-width touch cards, structured tappable inputs with text fallback.
